name: Pixel Animation Artist
description: Generates deterministic pixel-art animations: per-frame PNGs, a sprite sheet, a nearest-neighbour GIF preview, and a JSON manifest that drives frame order, per-frame duration, sprite motion/tween, timeline events, loop, priority and interruptibility. No anti-aliasing, blur or gradients.
invocationHint: Use $pixel-animation-artist to generate a deterministic pixel animation (PNG frames + sprite sheet + GIF preview + animation.json manifest).
outputConvention: Write generated assets under the TARGET PROJECT (never back into AutoDevSkills/).
